home.welcome: Welcome to Mahanaim Gospel Ministries International
home.hero_desc: Join Mahanaim Gospel Ministries International. Let's impact the world through anointed music, powerful outreach, and transformational community service.

features.music_desc: Live worship sessions, dedicated choir training, and collaborative gospel music projects aimed at spiritual elevation.
features.outreach_desc: Gospel Ministries dedicated to spreading the message of love and salvation around the nation and across borders.
features.training_desc: Equipping the next generation of leaders. Preparing those thirsty for truth to become men and women of God.

home.contact_desc: Have questions, prayer requests, or want to join the team? We'd love to hear from you.
home.form_alert: Our messaging system is currently being set up. Please contact us directly via email or our mobile number for now!

center.desc: A place of revival, healing, and intimate worship. Join our community and experience the presence of God in every service.
center.visit_desc: Find us at our central location and become part of the family.

programmes.desc: Discover the various ways we spread the gospel and nurture believers through dedicated ministries.

list.1_desc: Empowering the next generation with biblical foundations and fellowship.
list.2_desc: Special fasting prayers held every week to intercede for our community and nation.
list.3_desc: Dedicated sessions to train upcoming musicians and worship leaders.
list.4_desc: Taking the gospel to the streets and neighboring towns through open-air meetings.

team.title: The Mahanaim
team.desc: A collective of passionate, Spirit-led musicians, vocalists, and creatives committed to leading the congregation into the deep presence of God.
team.leader_desc: Prasanth leads the worship ministry with an immense passion for the presence of God. With years of experience in musical direction, he oversees the band, choir, and creative arts within Mahanaim.

pastor.desc: Meet Pastor Jimshu Varghese, a dedicated servant of God, leading Mahanaim Gospel Ministries with a passion for souls and a heart for revival.
pastor.bio_1: Pastor Jimshu Varghese has been the foundational pillar of Mahanaim Gospel Ministries International. With a deep, uncompromising calling to share the Word of God, he has dedicated his life to pastoring the Mahanaim Worship Center in Chelakkara.
pastor.bio_2: He is blessed with his wife and three wonderful children, who faithfully stand alongside him in ministry. Together, their family exemplifies a deep commitment to community service, spiritual mentorship, and the global spread of the Gospel.
pastor.mission_desc: His life's mission is to raise up a generation of uncompromising believers, rooted firmly in the scriptures, ready to manifest the power of the Holy Spirit across the globe.

footer.desc: Transforming lives through powerful worship, global outreach, and deeply rooted community service.
